content: Krishna Das contacted insurance agent Suresh Deshmukh to question the increased premium on their auto policy renewal. Suresh explained the rate adjustment was due to increased claims in the area and offered potential discounts, such as a higher deductible or a no-claim bonus. Krishna expressed interest in checking eligibility for the no-claim bonus and inquired about the renewal deadline.

action_items: Check if customer qualifies for the no-claim bonus
Provide the deadline for policy renewal
